terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.seoTitle: Terms of Service — Sphera by CampusSphere
terms.seoDesc: Review Sphera's Terms of Service: platform rules, ethical AI usage, and service commitments.

sec1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms & Minimum Age (16 years old)
sec1.p1: By accessing and using the Sphera platform (part of the CampusSphere ecosystem), you agree without reservation to these Terms of Service. Sphera usage is strictly restricted to students aged at least 16 years old. If you are between 16 and 18, you confirm having obtained prior permission from parents or legal guardians.

sec2.title: 2. Description of Service
sec2.p1: Sphera is a study assistance tool leveraging advanced Artificial Intelligence models to analyze academic materials, generate structured revision sheets, flashcards, interactive quizzes, and answer targeted questions about your coursework. Sphera serves as a methodological aid and does not replace official lectures, seminars, or instructor directives.

sec3.title: 3. Acceptable Use & Processing License
sec3.p1: You agree to use Sphera legally and ethically. The following activities are strictly prohibited:
sec3.item1: Uploading copyright-protected documents without holding the required authorizations.
sec3.item2: Using the platform to cheat during official exams or live graded evaluations.
sec3.item3: Attempting to bypass usage quotas, scrape content, or intentionally overload inference APIs.
sec3.p2: To enable parsing and reading of your files, you grant Sphera and CampusSphere a technical license to host and temporarily store your documents on Amazon Web Services (AWS S3).

sec4.title: 4. Reliability of AI-Generated Content
sec4.p1: Although we deploy rigorous enterprise technologies (AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Groq), AI models may occasionally produce errors or inaccuracies ('hallucinations'). Students remain solely responsible for verifying their knowledge against official lecture materials. CampusSphere assumes no liability for adverse academic grades or exam results.

sec5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sec5.p1: You retain all copyrights to your original coursework documents. Generated revision sheets and quizzes belong to you for your personal study use. However, source code, design assets, prompt templates, and the Sphera brand remain the exclusive property of CampusSphere.

sec6.title: 6. Study Passes, Subscriptions & Mobile Money
sec6.p1: During open beta, features are provided free of charge. Future paid offerings (Exam Passes, recurring subscriptions) are billed in CFA Francs (XAF) via Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money). Sales conditions, immediate execution, and non-cancellation after generation are governed by our Terms of Sale.

sec7.title: 7. Changes to Terms & Jurisdiction
sec7.p1: CampusSphere reserves the right to amend these terms at any time. These Terms are governed by the laws of Cameroon. Any disputes unresolved amicably will be submitted to the competent courts of Douala.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seoDesc: Review Sphera's Privacy Policy: personal data protection, secure document processing, and privacy commitments.

sec1.title: 1. Introduction & Unified Ecosystem
sec1.p1: Sphera is the AI academic assistant integrated into CampusSphere. Protecting your personal data and maintaining the confidentiality of your study materials are top priorities. This policy informs you about the collection, processing, and security of your data when using Sphera.

sec2.title: 2. Collected Data & Minimum Age (16 years old)
sec2.item1Desc: Sphera is reserved for students at least 16 years old. If you are a minor (16-18), you certify having obtained authorization from your parents or guardians.
sec2.item2Desc: Full name, student or personal email address, and higher education institution.
sec2.item3Desc: PDF files, lecture photographs, texts, and documents uploaded to generate study sheets, flashcards, and quizzes.
sec2.item4Desc: Learning analytics, quiz history, and pedagogical interactions with the AI.

sec3.title: 3. Document Processing & AI Security
sec3.p1: Your revision materials are processed by state-of-the-art AI models via Amazon Web Services (AWS Bedrock), supplemented by Google Gemini and Groq, for the sole and exclusive purpose of parsing your lectures and generating educational content.
sec3.commitment: Firm commitment: Your personal documents and study queries are NEVER sold, nor used to retrain public AI models of our infrastructure providers.

sec4.title: 4. Hosting & Cloud Subcontractors
sec4.p1: Your information is never transferred to advertisers. The only necessary technical disclosures involve our infrastructure partners:
sec4.item1Desc: Render Services, Inc. (with gradual migration towards Microsoft Azure for high-performance scalability).
sec4.item2Desc: Amazon Web Services (AWS) - Amazon S3 (encrypted storage at rest for your course documents).
sec4.item3Desc: AWS Bedrock, Google AI, and Groq Inc. (real-time processing with no retention for training).
sec4.item5Desc: Certified secure gateways (MTN MoMo, Orange Money) for study pass activations.

sec5.title: 5. Security
sec5.p1: We implement robust technical security measures (TLS encryption, secure storage, hashed credentials) and organizational safeguards to protect your data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.

sec6.title: 6. Your Rights
sec6.p1: In accordance with data protection regulations (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your personal data. You can delete all your study sessions, or your entire account, directly from the application settings. For any request, contact us at:
